Name: The Story of Adidon
Description:
The cover for "The Story of Adidon".

The picture used here is Drake in blackface with a Jim Crow shirt circa 2007 taken by David Leyes.

Drake responded to the cover by saying it wasn't from a brand shoot or his music career, but from an acting project about "young black actors struggling to get roles, being stereotyped and type cast." It was to highlight the frustrations for African American actors "not always getting a fair chance in the industry" and how these struggles have not changed since.

Name: The Story of Adidon
Description:
A wider version of "The Story of Adidon" cover, posted on Twitter by Pusha T saying the following and linking a website:

"Please stop referring to this picture as “artwork”...I’m not an internet baby, I don’t edit images...this is a REAL picture...these are his truths, see for yourself davidleyes.com/portraits.html"
